purpose: Provides the default ADR format, covering file naming, structure, optional scope block, how to write rejections, and the template, used when no project-specific ADR format exists.
summary: Default ADR format used when no project-specific format is found
File naming rule ADR-{NNN}_{feature}.md, one file per feature, number fixed at creation
File structure: single H1, numbered decision sections with four fixed subsections
Section numbers are never changed, and no metadata table or status history
Optional scope block placed after the H1 with paired in-scope and out-of-scope items
How to write rejections by rewriting the same decision section and moving the old option to alternatives
Full markdown template with guidance for alternatives and impact subsections
Impact must be evidence-based; no file path listings; use links rather than bare IDs
tasks: Adding a decision to an existing ADR
Revising or rejecting an existing decision
Writing the scope block of an ADR
title: ADR（アーキテクチャ決定記録）デフォルトフォーマット
